theater_event_24_03_09_303:
Ah!!
I'm so sorry! All that food...!!
theater_event_24_03_09_306:
Phew. I caught the dishes on this side.
Ryu, how about yours?
theater_event_24_03_09_307:
No problem here.
These dishes are safe too.
theater_event_24_03_09_308:
They caught every last plate that went flyin'...
What kinda crazy street act is this...?
theater_event_24_03_09_309:
Whew! Now that was a show! This is why
I can't quit The Benevolent Mistress.
theater_event_24_03_09_311:
We'll all be here to back you up, Bell,
so don't stress. Just take it nice and easy.
theater_event_24_03_09_312:
Ryu was way worse back when she was new.
You're adorable by comparison, adventurer boy.
theater_event_24_03_09_313:
She's better now, but you wouldn't believe
how many plates she broke and how many times
Mama Mia chewed her out.
theater_event_24_03_09_314:
That's true. She couldn't even peel a vegetable,
and she used to scare the customers—
theater_event_24_03_09_315:
—Now is not the time for reminiscing!
We need to recover, quickly!
theater_event_24_03_09_316:
Yeah, fair enough.
Let's get these dishes out there.
theater_event_24_03_09_320:
Suppose you ran into an endless Monster Party
like the situation we're in now.
What would you do?
theater_event_24_03_09_322:
...When you're cornered, stay calm and look for
the best move. Find what you can do, and
focus on that.
theater_event_24_03_09_323: Yes. In that case, observe your surroundings—
theater_event_24_03_09_327:
Ugh! Ughh...! I'M SO LONELYYYY!
LISTEN TO ME TALK MOOOOORE!!
theater_event_24_03_09_328:
—I can't take them all on at once.
So I pick them off one by one and wear down
their numbers?
theater_event_24_03_09_329: Do you think you could wear them all down?
theater_event_24_03_09_330:
No. I'm not strong enough yet.
If I charged in head-on,
I wouldn't stand a chance.
theater_event_24_03_09_332:
Retreat... But in this situation,
retreating means abandoning my friends—
theater_event_24_03_09_334:
—Please, give me orders!
What can I do to be useful to all of you?!
theater_event_24_03_09_335:
Yes. Accept that you're a rookie.
Trust your experienced allies.
That is the best move.
theater_event_24_03_09_336:
Hee hee, I'm glad you're relying on us.
Let's see... Something that plays
to your strengths...
theater_event_24_03_09_337:
Oh! I just had a great idea.
Though you might not like it, Bell.
theater_event_24_03_09_338:
No, I'll do anything!
I want to be useful to The Benevolent Mistress!
theater_event_24_03_09_339:
Hee hee. You said "anything," didn't you?
No backing out now.
theater_event_24_03_09_340: Of course! Ms. Syr, I'm counting on you!
theater_event_24_03_09_342:
See? There's no running away now.
Tee hee. Tonight's going to be a fun night♪
theater_event_24_03_10_343: Now then, Bell. Out front you go♪
theater_event_24_03_10_344:
But I can't go out in front of people
looking like this...
theater_event_24_03_10_345:
Belll?
You said you'd do anything, didn't you?
theater_event_24_03_10_349:
Welcome, dear customers...
Please make yourselves...at home...
theater_event_24_03_10_351:
What is this?! What is this?!
What IS thiiiiiiiis?!
theater_event_24_03_10_352:
Wait... What?!
What's with this insane commotion?!
theater_event_24_03_10_353:
Wherever there is cuteness, there are gods!
Don't underestimate our noses! Hah, hah...
Bell-kyuuun...
theater_event_24_03_10_354:
And where did you even come in from?!
The gods are pouring in one after another!
theater_event_24_03_10_355: No... It seems it isn't only the gods.
theater_event_24_03_10_357:
A boy in a dress...?
Prancin' around in a maid getup...
theater_event_24_03_10_358:
Dammit, he ain't half bad...
You idiot...
theater_event_24_03_10_359:
No way?!
Even the customers who were raging
a minute ago...?!
theater_event_24_03_10_360:
In any case, this is our chance!
We'll keep the place running while
the customers are calm!
theater_event_24_03_10_362:
Um, sir...
What would you like to order?
theater_event_24_03_10_366:
Certainly!
We're swamped with orders, so please
wait just a moment.
theater_event_24_03_10_367:
I'll wait... I'll wait as long as it takes...
So you'd better be the one to bring it!
theater_event_24_03_10_369:
Gaaah! Bell-kyun, you're so cute!
Bring us the most expensive wine in the house!
theater_event_24_03_10_370:
Us too, please! A toast to the new
"cute" of the Gods' Generation,
born right here in Orario!
theater_event_24_03_10_371:
Coming! Bell, we've got
an order from this table too!
theater_event_24_03_10_372:
I got to see something rare,
and my belly's full! I'm so happy~.
Thanks a bunch~.
theater_event_24_03_10_373:
Thank you so much!
Please come again~.
theater_event_24_03_10_374:
—Phew! A lot happened, but we made it
to closing time. Good work today, Bell!
theater_event_24_03_10_375:
Good work, everyone!
Um... I'm really sorry for all the trouble!
theater_event_24_03_10_376:
Don't sweat it, adventurer boy. If those two
idiot cats hadn't slacked off, it never
would've gotten so busy anyway.
theater_event_24_03_10_377:
You threw yourself into helping us.
We're nothing but grateful.
theater_event_24_03_10_378:
Yes. That outfit did surprise me
a little, but...
theater_event_24_03_10_379:
Thanks to you, Mr. Cranel, the nasty mood
in the tavern blew away in an instant.
theater_event_24_03_10_380:
Right? We pulled through because of you.
Thank you, Bell.
theater_event_24_03_10_381:
I'm glad I could help...
Though just remembering it makes my face
feel like it's on fire...
theater_event_24_03_10_382:
Hee hee, sorry.
But you looked super cute!
theater_event_24_03_10_384:
...So, how did you like your work experience
at The Benevolent Mistress?
theater_event_24_03_10_385:
Oh...
Um, how should I put it—
theater_event_24_03_10_388:
Everyone has amazing skills and ideas,
and they pour all of it into making sure
the customers have a good time...
theater_event_24_03_10_389:
I realized that's what a job is.
It's just...amazing...
theater_event_24_03_10_392: Aaah! White Hair is still here-nya!
theater_event_24_03_10_393:
But he's in his usual clothes-nya.
Where's the maid outfit everyone was
talking about?!
theater_event_24_03_10_394:
You two! Where have you been?!
We've had it rough over here!
theater_event_24_03_10_395:
Who cares about that-nya!
More importantly, there's a rumor something
fun happened here!
theater_event_24_03_10_396:
That's right-nya! We heard the boy was
in a maid outfit, going "moe moe kyun"
and wiggling his butt!
theater_event_24_03_10_398:
Ngh... To think we missed Pretty-Butt Boy
in such a rare outfit-nya...
Come here! Show us again-nya!
theater_event_24_03_10_400:
Yeah-nya, yeah-nya!
Show us the fun too-nya!
theater_event_24_03_10_405:
—YOU NUMBSKULLS!! Where have you
been loafing around all this time?!
theater_event_24_03_10_412:
Hurry up and take it.
It's what you earned.
theater_event_24_03_10_414:
Hee hee, how does it feel? Not an
adventurer's reward, but wages you earned
by working?
theater_event_24_03_10_417:
It's heavy...but I'm happy.
It feels like what I did today actually
helped everyone.
theater_event_24_03_10_419:
Don't make such a big deal of it. It's just pay
for working a day as part of this tavern.
Hold your head high and take it.
theater_event_24_03_10_420:
Yes, ma'am!
Thank you very much!
theater_tutorial_10020_01: I'm getting pretty used to this area, but...
theater_tutorial_10020_02:
Miss Eina said a single moment of carelessness
in the Dungeon can get you killed—
theater_tutorial_10040_01: All right! Time to do my best today too.
theater_tutorial_10040_02:
I'll earn a ton of money and treat
the Goddess to something delicious!
theater_tutorial_10060_01:
I can feel power...welling up.
Goddess! I can still keep going!
theater_tutorial_10080_01:
Clear a battle, and the next stage
opens up!
theater_tutorial_10080_02:
Keep up the good work, and clear
as many as you can!
theater_tutorial_10090_01:
Maybe I'm finally getting a little used to
exploring the Dungeon?
theater_tutorial_10090_02:
If I work harder, maybe someday I'll defeat
terrifying monsters like the heroes
in fairy tales—
theater_tutorial_10090_03:
And then, just like Grandpa said,
I'll meet a cute girl—!
theater_tutorial_10090_04: All right! Let's do our best today!!
theater_tutorial_10100_01:
Okay, okay, the moment you've been waiting for!
It's time to update your Status!
theater_tutorial_10100_02: Let's head back to our home first, shall we?
theater_tutorial_10110_01:
...Yep.
Looks like you're really getting the hang
of adventuring.
theater_tutorial_10110_02:
But the moment you get comfortable is when
it's most dangerous. How about trying out
a training battle for now?
theater_tutorial_10110_03:
Looks like the Guild hands out some sweet
rewards if you clear them, and they'll
definitely help you in the Dungeon!
theater_tutorial_10120_01:
You can come here for training anytime,
so give it a shot whenever you feel like it!
theater_tutorial_10130_01:
Congrats on clearing it!
You can finally pull the gacha!
theater_tutorial_10130_02:
Now then, let's try our luck and
meet some new friends!
theater_tutorial_10140_01:
So how'd it go?
Did you find some reliable friends?
theater_tutorial_10140_02:
Join forces with your friends, bust through
every challenge, and keep up the good work
exploring the Dungeon!
theater_tutorial_10140_03:
After all, this is the Familia Myth—
written by me, your goddess,
and walked by you—
theater_tutorial_10150_01:
Well?
Did your Status go up?
theater_tutorial_10150_02:
If you hit a wall exploring the Dungeon,
update your Status and try again.
theater_tutorial_10150_03:
I bet you'll be able to beat tough enemies
you couldn't beat before!
theater_tutorial_10160_01:
—Oh, right.
Before your next expedition, maybe I'll
entrust you with some of my power.
theater_tutorial_10160_02:
Even when we're far apart,
we're always connected!
theater_tutorial_10160_03:
That's the bond between a god and their child!
Don't hold back—you can count on me!
theater_tutorial_10180_01:
Once again, nice to have you!
Now put me in your party, and let's
head to the next battle!
theater_traning01_dialogue01_0020:
This training explains character switching
and the Defense Role.
theater_traning01_dialogue02_0010:
Some enemies may use powerful
charged attacks.
theater_traning01_dialogue02_0020:
Try switching to Welf,
an adventurer with the Defense Role.
theater_traning01_dialogue03_0010:
Defense Role adventurers
have high Endurance.
theater_traning01_dialogue03_0020:
Their defense-focused skills let you
greatly reduce damage taken.
theater_traning01_dialogue03_0030:
For big attacks you can't dodge, switch to
a Defense Role adventurer and tough it out!
theater_traning01_dialogue04_0010:
The Giant Kobold is charging another attack.
This time, try using Welf's Special.
theater_traning01_dialogue05_0010:
A Defense Role Special can knock enemies
down.
theater_traning01_dialogue05_0020: Knocking an enemy down interrupts its attack.
theater_traning01_dialogue06_0010:
You can also switch characters while
activating a Special. Aim to trigger it
at the most effective moment!
theater_traning02_dialogue01_0020:
This training explains the role of
the Support Role.
theater_traning02_dialogue02_0010:
You took heavy damage from a monster.
Try switching to a Support Role adventurer
to heal.
theater_traning02_dialogue03_0010:
Mikoto's Special restored the HP of Bell,
who is on standby.
theater_traning02_dialogue03_0020: Next, try using a skill with a support effect.
theater_traning02_dialogue04_0010:
Mikoto's skill increased the damage every
unit deals to enemies.
theater_traning02_dialogue05_0010:
Support Role adventurers can grant healing
and support effects to all standby units.
theater_traning03_dialogue01_0020:
This training explains enemy shields
and Breaks.
theater_traning03_dialogue02_0010:
The Giant Kobold has deployed a shield and
is preparing a powerful attack.
theater_traning03_dialogue02_0020:
Deal enough damage within the time limit
to interrupt the powerful attack.
theater_traning03_dialogue02_0030:
If you can't break it in time,
you'll take massive damage.
theater_traning04_dialogue01_0020:
This training covers the benefits
of Limit Breaking characters.
theater_traning04_dialogue01_0030:
In this training, take on the battle with
Bell and Hestia, both Limit Broken.
theater_traning04_dialogue02_0010:
Limit Breaking an adventurer once increases
their skills to two. Try them out!
theater_traning04_dialogue03_0010:
Limit Breaking an Assist lets it gain
passive skills that boost the unit's stats.
theater_traning04_dialogue03_0020:
At Limit Break 1, Hestia's healing skill
becomes more effective.
theater_traning04_dialogue04_0010:
As you can see, Limit Break doesn't just raise
a character's proficiency cap. It also grants
all kinds of abilities.
theater_traning04_dialogue04_0020: If your adventure stalls, try Limit Breaking.
theater_traning05_dialogue01_0010: TRAINING 5: Speed Role and Attack Role
theater_traning05_dialogue01_0020:
This training covers the differences between
the Speed Role and the Attack Role.
theater_traning05_dialogue01_0030:
In this training, take on the battle
with Bell and Bete.
theater_traning05_dialogue02_0010:
Both Attack and Speed Roles exist to deal
damage, but they have different traits.
theater_traning05_dialogue02_0020:
Attack Role adventurers have high-damage
skills, but lower charge efficiency for
activating them.
theater_traning05_dialogue02_0030:
Speed Role adventurers, on the other hand,
deal less skill damage but charge faster
with normal attacks.
theater_traning05_dialogue02_0040:
Charge up with a Speed Role, then use an
Attack Role's skills to deal damage
more efficiently.
theater_traning05_dialogue02_0050:
This training is more hands-on.
Give it a try!
theater_traning06_dialogue01_0020:
This training covers the elements
characters possess.
theater_traning06_dialogue01_0030:
This time, take on the battle with
Wind-element Bell.
theater_traning06_dialogue02_0010:
An enemy with an element has appeared.
An enemy's element is shown to the left
of its HP bar.
theater_traning06_dialogue02_0020:
This enemy is Fire-element.
Fire enemies are strong against Wind
and weak against Water.
theater_traning06_dialogue02_0030:
First, try fighting with a disadvantageous
element.
theater_traning06_dialogue03_0010:
Next, take on an enemy you have
the advantage against.
theater_traning06_dialogue04_0010:
These enemies had the same Status, but you
should have felt how elemental matchups
boosted your combat efficiency.
theater_traning06_dialogue04_0020:
You can also check elemental matchups on the
Party screen. Check them before you sortie.
theater_traning07_dialogue01_0030:
Battle Items can be equipped to units once
an adventurer reaches Limit Break 2.
theater_traning07_dialogue02_0010:
Equipping a Battle Item lets you use special
skills. Each Battle Item has a different
effect.
theater_traning07_dialogue02_0020:
This time, try using a "Magic Potion,"
which shortens a unit's cooldown.
theater_traning07_dialogue03_0010:
The "Magic Potion" made Bell's skill ready.
As a bonus effect, charge efficiency is also
raised for a while.
theater_traning07_dialogue03_0020:
Other Battle Items deal damage,
grant healing effects, and more.
theater_traning07_dialogue03_0030:
Higher-difficulty quests like Hard and
Very Hard drop Battle Items of higher rarity.
theater_traning07_dialogue03_0040:
Collect Battle Items to gain the upper hand
in battle.
theater_traning08_dialogue01_0020:
This training covers Elemental Shields
deployed by enemies.
theater_traning08_dialogue01_0030:
This time, take on the battle with Welf,
a Fire Attack Role, and Aisha,
a Lightning Attack Role.
theater_traning08_dialogue02_0010:
Enemies with an element may deploy a shield
with the same elemental traits.
theater_traning08_dialogue02_0020:
This Giant Kobold has deployed a Water shield.
First, try attacking with Welf, whose Fire
element is at a disadvantage.
theater_traning08_dialogue03_0010:
Next, try Aisha, whose Lightning element
has the advantage.
theater_traning08_dialogue04_0010:
When an enemy deploys an Elemental Shield,
deal damage with a favorable element.
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_002:
(I knew he'd been through something
out of the ordinary, but... that alone
can't explain it.)
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_003:
(The cause has to be... this "rare skill"
I've never heard of anywhere else...
Liaris Freese!)
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_005:
(Skill effect: rapid growth. Lasts as long
as the feelings continue, and grows
stronger with the depth of those feelings...)
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_006:
What's with these "feelings"?!
Bell, you two-timer! You total two-timer!
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_008:
(...But should I really tell Bell
these numbers as they are...?)
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_010:
(With other gods watching, I can't
tell him about the skill, but...)
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_011:
Bell, mind if I just tell you your Status
out loud today?
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_014: (I'll give this kid a push forward.)
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_015:
Wh-what?! My Status went up
that much?!
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_016:
Yeah. Right now, you're growing
frighteningly fast. You could call it
a growth spurt.
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_017:
...This is just my personal opinion,
but I think you've got talent.
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_018:
...You'll get strong, I know it.
And you want to be stronger than you are
now, too.
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_020:
...I'll respect that wish of yours. I'll cheer
you on, help you, lend you my strength.
So I want you to promise me something.
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_021:
Promise you won't push yourself too hard
anymore. ...Please, don't leave me all alone.
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_023:
I'll work hard to get stronger, but I'll never
leave you alone, Goddess.
I won't make you worry.
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_024: Hearing that puts my mind at ease.
theater_main_quest_01_02_01_025:
And so, Bell!
I'm gonna be away for two or three days
starting tonight. That okay?
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_002:
Not to brag, but do you have any idea
how much a custom order from us costs?
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_004:
Then save up your money.
We'll talk after that...
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_008:
And what is that pose supposed to be?
What are you doing?
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_009:
...A dogeza.
Takemikazuchi told me about it—the ultimate
technique for apologies and favors...
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_010: That guy and his useless advice...
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_011:
...Tell me, Hestia.
Why are you going this far?
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_013:
That kid is trying to change!
He's found a goal, and he's about to start
running down a long, steep road!
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_014:
It's a dangerous road, so I need it!
The power to help him along!
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_015: A weapon that can carve out his path!
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_016:
He's always the one helping me!
All I do is let him support me!
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_017:
I'm his goddess, but I can't do a single
thing a goddess is supposed to!
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_018:
...I hate not being able to do anything
for him...
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_022:
I'll make a weapon.
For your child.
theater_main_quest_01_02_02_024:
Just so you know, you're paying for it.
Even if it takes decades. Centuries.
theater_main_quest_01_02_03_002:
Wait up, White Hair!
I need a favor-nya~.
theater_main_quest_01_02_03_006:
Sooo!
You're gonna take this "wallet" to
scatterbrained Syr-nya!
theater_main_quest_01_02_03_007:
Um...
...Sorry, I'm still not quite following.
theater_main_quest_01_02_03_009:
Anya, that's not enough of an explanation.
Mr. Cranel is confused.
theater_main_quest_01_02_03_011:
Syr skipped her shift to go see
Monsterphilia, and we want you to deliver
the wallet she forgot-nya.
theater_main_quest_01_02_03_015:
Syr didn't skip work, of course. She took
the day off to see the festival. She must be
in trouble without her wallet by now.
theater_main_quest_01_02_03_018:
Got it.
Leave it to me!
theater_main_quest_01_02_04_002:
Took a fancy to some other Familia's
kid again, and now yer gonna meddle?
theater_main_quest_01_02_04_004:
...Jeez, always sowin' seeds of trouble,
ya lovesick goddess.
theater_main_quest_01_02_04_005:
So what kinda kid is it?
The one yer after?
theater_main_quest_01_02_04_006:
Very unreliable, the kind of child who cries
at the slightest thing... But he was beautiful.
Translucent.
theater_main_quest_01_02_04_007:
He had a color I'd never seen before.
I found him by pure chance—he just happened
to catch my eye...
theater_main_quest_01_02_04_011: Forgive me. Something urgent has come up.
theater_main_quest_01_02_04_012:
Huh?
You can't just up and—
theater_main_quest_01_02_04_014: What's her deal?! And I'm stuck with the bill?!
theater_main_quest_01_02_05_001: Finding Ms. Syr is gonna be tough...
theater_main_quest_01_02_05_003:
Goddess?!
What are you doing here?!
theater_main_quest_01_02_05_004: Well, because I wanted to see you, I guess.
theater_main_quest_01_02_05_005:
Uh, okay...
I wanted to see you too, but...
theater_main_quest_01_02_05_006:
Wonderful!
We really are bound by an extraordinary bond!
theater_main_quest_01_02_05_008:
Let's go on a date,
Bell!
theater_main_quest_01_02_05_010:
W-wait, Goddess?!
Someone asked me to find a person!
theater_main_quest_01_02_05_011:
Is that so?
Then we'll look while we're on our date.
Two birds with one stone!
theater_main_quest_01_02_05_015:
Hmm, so the person you're looking for
is a girl, huh? You sure don't miss a beat,
Bell.
theater_main_quest_01_02_05_022:
B-B-Bell?
That thing... It isn't...looking at me...
is it?
theater_main_quest_01_02_06_003: We have no choice but to go in!
theater_main_quest_01_02_06_011: (Don't run away and leave a girl behind!!)
theater_main_quest_01_02_07_001:
It's no use...
I'm not strong enough to protect the Goddess!
theater_main_quest_01_02_07_002:
At this rate, it'll catch up...
What do I do? What do I do?!
theater_main_quest_01_02_07_006:
...I'm sorry, Goddess.
I'll buy us time. You keep running.
theater_main_quest_01_02_07_007:
What are you saying, Bell?!
Open this up right now!
theater_main_quest_01_02_07_009: I don't want to lose my family ever again.
theater_main_quest_01_02_09_002:
That knife has a Status, just as you
carved into it with Hieroglyphs.
theater_main_quest_01_02_09_005:
